messages.ADMIN.COMPANY_INTRO: Your company's identity, legal entities, defaults and size at a glance.

messages.ADMIN.COMPANY_TIME_ZONE_HINT: An IANA time zone, for example America/New_York.

messages.ADMIN.ORG_INTRO: The company's units, who manages them and who works in them.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_SEARCH_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Try a different name or code, or clear the search to see the whole tree.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Start by adding the first unit, such as a state or region. Everything else hangs below it.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_SELECT_UNIT: Select a unit in the tree to see its managers and people.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_ADD_UNIT_HELP: Choose what kind of unit it is and where it belongs. Some types can only sit under certain parents.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_PARENT_HINT: Leave empty for a top-level unit.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_MOVE_HELP: Moving a unit moves everything below it. A unit cannot go under itself or its own sub-units.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_ARCHIVE_HELP: The unit is kept as history but disappears from the tree. It must have no active sub-units and no people currently placed in it.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_END_MANAGER_HELP: The person stops managing this unit from now on. The record stays in the history.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_MANAGERS_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Add the employees who are responsible for this unit. Managing a unit does not by itself give anyone access to its data.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_PEOPLE_EMPTY_TITLE: Nobody is placed in this unit
messages.ADMIN.ORG_PEOPLE_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Assign an employee to place them in this unit. Their placement history is kept.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_ASSIGN_HELP: A primary placement transfers the person here and closes their previous one. The history stays.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_ASSIGNMENT_ENDS_HINT: Required for a temporary assignment; leave empty otherwise.
messages.ADMIN.ORG_VIEW_HISTORY: View the change history of this unit
messages.ADMIN.BRANCH_INTRO: Every branch with its address, place in the organization, manager, people and opening hours.
messages.ADMIN.BRANCH_PARENT_HINT: A branch belongs to a city or a region.
messages.ADMIN.BRANCH_HOURS_HINT: Leave both times empty for a day the branch is closed. Times are in the branch's own time zone.
messages.ADMIN.BRANCH_SERVICES_NOTE: Service categories become available with the jobs module, so none are shown yet.
messages.ADMIN.BRANCH_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Add a branch under a city or region to record its address, hours and people.
messages.ADMIN.HISTORY_INTRO: Who changed the structure and where people were placed over time. Entries are never edited or removed.
messages.ADMIN.HISTORY_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Changes appear here as soon as units are added, moved or archived, or people are placed.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEES_INTRO: The people you manage. You only see employees inside your own units and only the fields your access allows.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEES_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Add the first employee to start building your team.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEES_EMPTY_FILTERED: No employee matches these filters. Clear them to see everyone you can access.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEE_LEGAL_EMPLOYER_HINT: The company that legally employs this person. It is independent of the team they work in.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEE_TEAM_HINT: Where they work from day one. You can change it later and the history is kept.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEE_FIELDS_HIDDEN_NOTE: Some fields are hidden because your access level does not include them.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEE_PLACEMENTS_EMPTY_DESCRIPT: Assign this employee to a unit to record where they work.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEE_END_ASSIGNMENT_HELP: The extra placement ends now. A primary placement can only end by a transfer or when employment ends.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEE_NO_LOGIN: This employee has no login yet. Accounts are created only by invitation.
messages.ADMIN.EMPLOYEE_TERMINATE_HELP: The record is kept. Open placements and manager roles end, the login is deactivated and all its sessions are signed out. This cannot be undone here.
messages.ADMIN.INVITE_HELP: The person receives a single-use link to set their own password. You never see or share the link.
messages.ADMIN.INVITE_EMAIL_HINT: Leave empty to use the email on the employee record.
messages.ADMIN.INVITE_ROLE_HINT: Optional. The role is granted when the invitation is accepted, only over the scope below.
messages.ADMIN.SCOPE_HELP: Which records the role applies to. A role always needs a scope.
messages.ADMIN.SCOPE_TYPE_ORG_UNIT: A unit and the units below it
messages.ADMIN.SCOPE_TARGET_HINT: Used only with the matching scope above.
messages.ADMIN.SCOPE_THIS_UNIT_ONLY: This unit only (not the units below it)
messages.ADMIN.USERS_INTRO: Logins in your scope. Accounts are created only when an invited employee accepts, so nobody shares an account.
messages.ADMIN.USERS_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Invite an employee to give them a login.
messages.ADMIN.USERS_DEACTIVATE_HELP: The person is signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in. Their records and history are kept.
messages.ADMIN.INVITATIONS_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Invitations you send appear here with their status.
messages.ADMIN.INVITATIONS_NOTE: A link is valid for 72 hours and works once. Sending a new invitation cancels the earlier link.

messages.ADMIN.ROLES_MFA_OPTIONAL: Two-step sign-in is not required for this role.
messages.ADMIN.ROLES_ARCHIVE_HELP: An archived role grants nothing from now on. Its history is kept.
messages.ADMIN.ROLES_ASSIGNMENTS_EMPTY_DESCRIPTIO: Assign the role to a person with a data scope.
messages.ADMIN.ROLES_EXPIRES_HINT: Leave empty for no end date. Use it for temporary access.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_TITLE: Why can this user access this record?
messages.ADMIN.WHY_HELP: Pick a user and, optionally, a permission and a record to see which role and scope grant it, or why access is denied. Effective access is shown right now, including expired and revoked grants.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_PERMISSION_HINT: Leave empty to list everything the user can do.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_RECORD_HINT: Optional. Paste the id of the record to check.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_VIA: Granted by the role {role} through a scope of type: {scope}.

messages.ADMIN.WHY_REASON_NO_PERMISSION: No active role of this user grants the permission.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_REASON_CONDITION_NOT_MET: A role grants the permission, but its conditions exclude this access.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_REASON_NO_SCOPE: A role grants the permission, but the assignment has no data scope.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_REASON_OUT_OF_SCOPE: A role grants the permission, but the record is outside the assignment's data scope.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_REASON_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The record does not exist in this company.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: This account is not active, so none of the grants below apply.
messages.ADMIN.WHY_NO_PERMISSIONS: This user currently holds no permissions.
messages.ADMIN.LOCALIZATION_INTRO: Reword built-in texts for your company. A change goes live only after a different person reviews and approves exactly that text.
messages.ADMIN.LOCALIZATION_ADD_HELP: Saved texts wait for review and are not shown to users until approved.
messages.ADMIN.LOCALIZATION_PLACEHOLDER_HINT: Keep every placeholder in curly braces exactly as in the built-in text.

messages.ADMIN.LOCALIZATION_EDIT_HELP: Editing sends the text back to review, even if it was live.

messages.ADMIN.LOCALIZATION_DELETE_HELP: The built-in text is used again straight away.
messages.ADMIN.LOCALIZATION_SAVED: Saved. It will go live after review.
